title: Structured release-notes source
description: Per-release source of truth at release-notes/v<X>.<Y>.<Z>.json, hand-written for the release being cut. scripts/consolidate-release-notes.js folds it into the minor series file release-notes/v<X>.<Y>.x.json, and scripts/generate-changelog-entry.js renders the whole set into CHANGELOG.md or one version for a release page; every string runs through a leak-vocabulary sweep before any markdown is emitted.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema file. Lets editors validate the JSON inline.

version.description: Strict semver (digits + dots, no `v` prefix). Matches the file's basename (vX.Y.Z.json).

headline.description: Single-line summary. No trailing punctuation. Starts with capital letter or backtick. Operator-facing, so the leak-vocabulary sweep rejects phase / sweep / tier / batch / group / slice numbering and AI-tooling names.

summary.description: Optional. 1-3 sentences expanding the headline. Ends with sentence punctuation.

title.description: Short item title. No trailing punctuation. Starts with letter or backtick.

body.description: Explanatory prose for the item. Ends with sentence punctuation.
